name: pulse-performance-vercel
description: Applies Vercel-style React performance practices to components in this Laravel Inertia app. Use for hydration safety, render cost, memoization, lazy imports, bundle size, waterfalls, media loading, request count, Suspense, and responsive performance.
purpose: Keep component rendering fast, hydration stable, bundles lean, and loading behaviour intentional.
single_responsibility: Render and load performance for components: deterministic hydration, render cost, memoization, lazy imports, and waterfalls.
triggers: Component affects first paint, hydration, large lists, or bundle size
Render cost, request count, or lazy loading is changing
There is a hydration mismatch warning
A heavy library or import may be introduced
completion_criteria: Initial render is deterministic and free of hydration mismatches
Static values are hoisted and expensive work is kept out of render
Memoization is applied only when identity or cost justifies it
Heavy optional features are lazy-imported and independent async work is started early
validation_criteria: Relevant build, type, and lint checks are identified
failure_handling: If a performance fix would change behaviour or cannot be verified, stop and report it instead of applying a speculative optimization.
Report any build, type, or hydration check that could not be run.
escalation_path: Route uncertain React, hydration, or Vite performance APIs through pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when a performance fix requires a scope, dependency, or behaviour change.
Hand media loading to pulse-media-assets and animation-loop cost to pulse-motion-interactions.
responsibilities: Choose memoization only when identity or cost matters.
Recommend lazy imports for heavy optional features.
Coordinate media loading with the media assets skill.
Keep animation loops, observers, and timers idle when components are offscreen or users are interacting directly.
